source: standard AWG conductor areas and conductor resistivity figures at 75 °C
basis: AWG areas: the standard circular-mil area of each American Wire Gauge size, 18 to 4/0 (the gauge's definition, rounded as commonly published). Ω·cmil/ft: the usual 75 °C conductor factors, 12.9 for uncoated copper and 21.2 for aluminum. Ω·mm²/m: the standard 20 °C resistivities, annealed copper 0.017241 (IEC 60028, temperature coefficient 0.00393 per K) and hard-drawn aluminium 0.028264 (IEC 60889, 0.00403 per K), corrected to 75 °C as rho20 × (1 + alpha20 × 55). Standard engineering figures; an organisation's own book wins.
